capabilities: embed live OneNote desktop windows inside notes
browse notebooks, sections, and pages in a sidebar tree
select pages via cascading dropdowns in code blocks
convert OneNote XML content to HTML with tables, images, and ink
extract preview images from handwritten ink pages
extras: Windows-only for embedding; macOS limited to basic sidebar browsing via AppleScript. On first launch the plugin automatically downloads two helper executables (onenote-repos.exe, win-embed-overlay.exe) from the GitHub release. Only one active embed session at a time.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to view or edit OneNote content, so users must switch to the OneNote app or export content to use it alongside their notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin communicates with the OneNote desktop application through the Windows COM interface.

summary: Embeds and edits OneNote notes inside Obsidian via local COM integration with the OneNote desktop app, including live window embedding.
